data.name: Onboarding_Welcome
data.value: Files, clipboard, notifications and tabs between iPhone, Mac and PC. Works right away on the same network — nothing to install or set up.

data.name: Onboarding_SendBody
data.value: Drop a file on a device in Nearby. Or right-click it in File Explorer and choose “Send with NitroDrop”.

data.name: Onboarding_HotkeyHint
data.value: sends what you copied to the device you used last

data.name: Onboarding_ReceiveBody
data.value: On your iPhone, tap Share → AirDrop and choose this PC. For now this works on the same Wi-Fi network; after Advanced Setup, the iPhone connects directly.

data.name: Onboarding_ReceiveLater
data.value: You can run Advanced Setup later: Settings → Wi-Fi driver.

data.name: Onboarding_PhoneTitle
data.value: Your phone, right on your desk

data.name: Onboarding_PhoneBody
data.value: Calls, messages and notifications from an iPhone paired over Bluetooth appear on this PC, and you can answer them right here.

data.name: Onboarding_DevicesTitle
data.value: Pick up where you left off

data.name: Onboarding_DevicesBody
data.value: Paired PCs see each other's open tabs and apps. The browser extension brings your tabs, and the iPhone shortcut brings whatever is open on your phone.

data.name: Onboarding_FinalBody
data.value: Nothing is received without your OK, and your contacts and files stay on this PC.
